observable: Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of blood pressure readings in extreme temperature conditions (0°C to 50°C)
baseline: Conventional blood pressure monitors without temperature compensation (MAE: 5.2 mmHg)
conditions: Temperature fluctuations between 0°C and 50°C, with a 10-minute adaptation period for the machine learning algorithm
falsifier: If the MAE of blood pressure readings in extreme temperature conditions is greater than 7.3 mmHg, or if the device fails to adapt to temperature changes within the 10-minute period
